source_snapshot.procedure: Configure IPv6, verify address/LED, ping peer, remove cable, recheck address/LED.
source_snapshot.criteria: IPv6 correct/LED on/ping succeeds; after removal address disabled and LED off.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL configures address only, omitting DAD/neighbor/cable/LED/recovery.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Requires isolated IPv6 plan, DAD/neighbor/zone, operator evidence, OOB and disabled-semantics clarification.

old_problem: The phrase 'IPv6 addresses should be disable' conflated persistent global/link-local assignment with carrier, neighbor and reachability loss.
disposition_reason: Linux kernel operational-state authority defines an unplugged Ethernet interface as operationally down and unable to transfer data, distinct from configured addresses. Therefore global/link-local IPv6 need not disappear; carrier, usable neighbor/path and peer reachability must fail. IPv6 DAD/zone/route specifics remain runtime bindings.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row67 all18 XLSX cells and history2678.
Applied Linux operational-state semantics while preserving IPv6-specific DAD, neighbor and scope behavior.
Kept operator cable/LED plus reconnect/rollback coverage; no state changed.

test_case.test_name: Parameterized Mellanox IPv6 DAD, cable-loss, neighbor and LED recovery validation
test_case.purpose: Verify approved IPv6 configuration completes DAD and peer reachability, then loses carrier/path/LED on unplug and safely restores neighbor connectivity after reconnect.
required_package: Conflict-free global IPv6/prefix/zone/route/peer plan plus link-local policy
Independent OOB/console and operator for cable/LED evidence
Carrier/ping6/neighbor recovery timeouts, baseline and rollback
test_case.test_command: Capture baseline IPv6/routes/neighbors/link; apply only approved global IPv6 configuration and wait for DAD success, validate correct scoped peer ping and neighbor state, and photograph LED on. Operator unplugs the mapped cable; verify operstate/carrier down, unusable neighbor/path, ping failure and LED off while recording retained global/link-local assignments. Reconnect, prove bounded DAD/neighbor/ping recovery as applicable and restore baseline.
test_case.expected_result: IPv6 configuration and DAD succeed, scoped peer reachability works with LED/link up, unplug causes operational/path failure and LED off, reconnect recovers, and baseline is restored without errors.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires IPv6/DAD/route/neighbor correctness, physical LED/cable evidence, carrier and reachability loss, recovery and rollback. Retained global/link-local addresses during carrier down are not failure.
safety_gate: Use mapped non-management port and conflict-free IPv6/prefix/zone.
Operator owns cable and LED evidence.
Require OOB and exact baseline before address changes.
Abort on DAD duplicate, wrong cable, management impact or recovery timeout; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: DAD, routes, neighbors and successful scoped ping
Unplug operstate/carrier/neighbor/ping failure plus LED-off photo
test_case.recovery: On DAD failure, wrong cable or incomplete neighbor recovery, stop, reconnect the mapped cable, use OOB to restore recorded IPv6/routes/admin state, preserve DAD/neighbor/carrier/LED evidence, and require IPv6 owner review before retry.

source_conflict.reason: Official Linux operational-state semantics resolve disabled as carrier/path unavailability, not required removal of global or link-local assignments.

blocked.reason: Review is complete; IPv6/peer/zone/cable/operator inputs gate execution.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Bind port/cable, IPv6/prefix/zone/peer, DAD/neighbor policy, LED, timeouts and rollback.
pending.unlock_condition: No Engineering Decision remains; incomplete IPv6 project bindings prevent execution/PASS.

external_authorities.name: Linux kernel Operational States
external_authorities.use: Defines administrative versus operational state and IF_OPER_DOWN for unplugged Ethernet unable to transfer data.
